refill.why: The Korean 느껴질 거라는 것 is a stiff nominal fragment, and it does not clearly show that byddai means 'would' rather than 'will'. The three BUILD slots are already filled by stronger rows.
The Korean 느껴지지 않을 거야 means 'won't', so it points to fydd hynna ddim as much as to fyddai hynna ddim. That gives two possible Welsh answers.
The Korean 느껴질 거라고 has the same problem: it fits both fydd and byddai. Five stronger USE rows are already kept.
